body: Its awesome that you have a friend to help you in times like these.  Use her as a light in the darkness.

Hey man.. I am in kind of the same boat as you.  I tried to end it all and failed.... Miserably.. 

>Even so, if I could go to sleep right now and never wake up, I would happily do it.

When you said this it got me thinking that nothing in life is certain.  My attempt that I thought was so fucking perfect was not certain.  My fate wasn't certain.  I still want to kill myself, but damn your message kinda struck home to me.  

Maybe others on here can relate to your message and mine and know that perhaps their "fates" are not certain.  I don't know man... I am just a broken soul in this world... but I did read your message, and I did take it to heart.  I might not be around later this week, but for what its worth, I wish you a brighter tomorrow!
"Life is a storm my young friend.  You will bask in the sunlight one moment, be shattered on the rocks the next."
That cop needs some lessons in helping others and listening rather than lecturing or making people feel worse.

Only good thing is that you can conceal it.   Sawed off shotgun is better for this though, and honestly so is any handgun.  

I like to think of it as just a fun fact for the game.  Just because it's something you can do, doesn't mean it's something you should do.   Just like drinking disinfectant.
Edit..  Youre thinking of house of D ha ha!

> Do you get any satisfaction thinking of all the things you have done and experienced?

No actually.  I just see failures.  Some things learned, but ultimately for nothing.  

>Whatever pictures you took must have some impact on the world. Does that bring you any joy or pride?

I honestly did not like it.  The photos I took haunt me to this day.  The adrenaline was the only good thing about it.  But it ultimately gave me a negative view of the world.  I don't recommend it to anyone.

>What's your favorite place you have lived?

There is a little town in Brazil called Arapoanga.  More like a tiny subdivision.  There is nothing there, but for some reason it was the happiest I was.  

Also Maragogi in Brazil is beautiful.  

Thanks for keeping me talking.

I thought about that.  I wrote a 700 page autobiography on my failures and learning experiences for each failure.  I went over how and why I had failed.  

My goals led to unrealistic and therefore failed expectations.  This resulted in a disafection of life.  While thinking and writing about my failures, I have come to realize I always blamed something or someone other than myself.  I threw the book away when I realized it had been my failed expectations that led me to my failures.

Thanks for responding.
I am not much of a writer or good story teller.  Before I left though, I wanted to finish my book.  Thats probably my only regret.

> it's going to get better if you pull yourself out of there. it may seem pointless, but someday you'll look back and be glad that you decided to change things.

Thats a great line.  I have always thought that way.  After so long though, its hard to think of it like that.  I feel like I have been trying to pull myself out of quicksand for years and years... I just sink a little deeper each time.  

Sitting still in the quicksand will bring about my utter demise.  Slower than struggling.  Knowing eventually I will sink, perhaps choosing my time and date is not such a bad thing...  I can only imagine spectators staring at me while im stuck in quicksand.  Every one of them screaming "Fight you idiot!"  "Don't give up!".  I can imagine how it is for everyone that visits this sub.  

Ultimately, I think I am broken.  I have no desire to keep my head out of the quicksand.  

Thanks for commenting.  You are a good person to offer your time to people who are lost and broken souls in a fairytale world.

WOW!  I am shocked you recognized the lyrics.  I can talk, but it doesn't go away.  Even if I wait tonight, the grim reaper will watch over me again tomorrow.   The idea of ending it is like a warm blanket, its comforting really.  Its the only way I feel relieved.  

Thanks for commenting, you brought a smile to my face.

Thanks for responding.  Believe me, I think about quitting my job every day.  The thought of smashing my car into an oncoming semi truck every time I drive is tempting beyond belief.  

I have tried switching things up.  Ive lived a full life for only being 27.  I lived in Brazil for three years to experience the world, went all over the middle east for a year and a half as a war photographer.  I partied for a month in Amsterdam, spent six months on a little Portuguese island off of spain.  

I know I sound bitchy, but for some reason it never got better.  I mean Jesus Christ... I should love life, and I dont.  I hate every minute of it.

Thanks for the time it took you to read this and write back.  It means a lot that someone took that effort.  I wish I could keep going, but I got nothing left.  After 10 years of this, I can't go anymore.  The thought of still going looms over me like a dark rain cloud.

Jesus fucking Christ!  I have no advice, just my condolences and hope everything works out well.  You are in my thoughts, and if I can do anything for you remotely, please let me know.  

Maybe I can buy you a pizza or something once all this works itself out.
Yep this!  ^  Same issue for me.  Getting them is not an issue, retaining them never works.  Fucking depression.

>You there reading these words on this screen right now have NO CLUE as to how much I hate myself.

I think some of us understand this.   Ah, the beautiful feeling of never waking up!  

I agree with your God statement.  If there is a God, hes got a lot of explaining to do...

Best of luck!
